agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 Annual Report and audited Consolidated Financial Statements, granting a full discharge of responsibility to the Board of Directors and Commissioners. The audit was performed by Kantor Akuntan Publik Y. Santosa & Rekan.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved the company's decision not to distribute any dividends for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025.
Agenda #3: Authority was granted to the Board of Commissioners to appoint a public accounting firm to audit the 2026 fiscal year financial statements and determine the honorarium.
Agenda #4: The meeting accepted the resignation of Gilarsi Wahju Setijono and established the new leadership composition for 2026-2031, appointing Anindra Ardiansyah Bakrie as President Director and Sharif Cicip Sutardjo as President Commissioner.
Agenda #5: Authority was given to the Nomination and Remuneration Committee via the Board of Commissioners to set the 2026 salary, allowances, and facilities for the company's leadership.
Agenda #6: The company presented the report regarding the realization of the use of proceeds from the 2025 Initial Public Offering.
Agenda #7: Shareholders approved the plan to increase company capital through a Rights Issue (PMHMETD I) by issuing up to 25,000,000,000 new shares.
Agenda #8: The meeting approved increasing the company's authorized capital from Rp800,000,000,000 to Rp1,750,000,000,000, resulting in an amendment to Article 4 paragraph (1) of the Articles of Association.
Agenda #9: Shareholders approved the amendment of Article 4 paragraph (2) regarding the increase of issued and paid-up capital in connection with the implementation of the PMHMETD I.
Agenda #10: The meeting approved adjusting the company's business activities and purposes in Article 3 of the Articles of Association to align with the 2025 Indonesia Standard Industrial Classification (KBLI).
